notes.title: Major Update Notice - Added Mutant Flame Card
notes.content:
Respected Players of "Game of Fate",

The new version 0.1.0 has introduced the Mutant Flame Card. Please update your client to version 0.1.0 as soon as possible after the new version is released. We will launch an event on March 18th at 10:00 AM, during which you will have a chance to obtain the Mutant Flame Card.

If you continue to use an older version after the event starts, you may encounter errors when claiming chests, resulting in failure to receive them successfully.
Thank you for your understanding and support!

Friendly Reminder: Restarting Steam can quickly fetch the update.

Attachment: Probability table for obtaining the Mutant Flame Card is provided below.
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45280261/d580ca5546fe6aac1678fde1eb72e411eb6169c7.png[/img]

tags.feature: The new version 0.1.0 has introduced the Mutant Flame Card.

tags.bug: If you continue to use an older version after the event starts, you may encounter errors when claiming chests, resulting in failure to receive them successfully.

notes.title: Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear “GameOfFate” Players,

We sincerely apologize for the unexpected issues in the newly released version 0.0.11, which caused abnormal visual effects with the Tarot card’s ripple art for some players. To ensure a smooth experience, we have urgently rolled back to the stable version 0.0.10.

We deeply regret any inconvenience this may have caused and appreciate your understanding and support.

Tip: Restart Steam to receive the update promptly.

tags.bug: We sincerely apologize for the unexpected issues in the newly released version 0.0.11, which caused abnormal visual effects with the Tarot card’s ripple art for some players.

notes.title: Major Update Announcement-1107
notes.content:
Hello everyone, greetings from “Game of Fate” development team.

This is the 4th update since our official release, please keep supporting “Game of Fate” and we are trying our best to maximize your experience.

This update includes:

1.Display names for tarot cards that have not been unlocked
2.Added notification for when videos cannot play on PC
3.Added a pop-up for selecting hardware decoding upon first game launch
4.Added Korean language support
5.Fixed an issue where turning off the main character's voice did not work in certain videos
6.Fixed missing images in 4K mode
7.Enhanced Jiang Zhengxiong’s manuscript content
8.Improved the experience of the message board (Hyperspace Communicator)
9.Fixed a crash issue caused by inserting a game controller
10.Optimized effects in certain videos

Restart Steam can achieve update content quickly.
Please keeping participating in our Tarots event!

notes.title: Update announcement-1031
notes.content:

notes.title: Demo Update Announcement-Fourth update
notes.content:

This is the fourth update to demo since Demo release.
Thank you so much for your like and support of “Game of Fate” Demo. We have collected optimization suggestions through multiple channels, such as QQ Group and in-game feedback. We have fixed problems that were reported by a large number of players and we will continue our optimization work.We value your feedback.
